column2: Build the AI system inventory with role per system
Deliver AI literacy to staff who operate or use AI
Screen every system against Article 5 practices and record the outcome
Classify each system against Annex I and Annex III; document non-high-risk conclusions
Data governance for training, validation and test data
Instructions for deployers and human-oversight design
Conformity assessment, EU declaration and CE marking; registration in the EU database
Deployer duties: use per instructions, oversight, logs, worker information, FRIA where required
Technical documentation, downstream information, copyright policy, training-content summary
Systemic-risk models: evaluation, incident reporting, cybersecurity
Chatbot disclosure, synthetic-content marking, deepfake and AI-text labelling
Assemble the evidence pack: inventory, screening records, classifications, test reports, oversight procedures
Post-market monitoring plan and serious-incident reporting process
